M12 covers monetary remedies, sanctions, set-off and overlap; M13 covers forum/adjudication while keeping enforceability and procedure in the external-law layer. M00-M11, cross-mechanism connectors and retrieval clusters are tightened accordingly. Every material printed mechanism in the currently reviewed corpus now has an explicit home, without claiming universal completeness for all Israeli leases. This remains documentation/research only: no Router schema, Gold labels, runtime rules, statutory authority, provider use or privacy boundary changes. Next, evaluate fresh concealed synthetic clauses in a separate model context, count omissions/excess routes and test linked-clause retrieval without sending real contracts to an external provider.
